275.name: Viral load testing coverage rate

277.name: TB Case fatality rate

278.name: TB Case notification rate

284.name: PLHIV  newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy

287.name: Malaria incidence per 1000 population

288.name: Percentage (%) of pregnant women on Intermittent preventive treatment (at least three doses of SP) according to national policy (HMIS)
288.description: This indicator assesses the proportion of pregnant women attending antenatal clinics (registrants) who received at least 3 doses of IPTp under direct observation of a health worker. In Ghana, all pregnant women are required to receive minimum of three doses and maximum of 5 doses of SP, during regularly scheduled antenatal visits under the direct observation of a health worker. This indicator assesses the extent of implementation of IPTp for programmatic decisions.
288.objective_name: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

289.name: Case fatality rates for epidemic prone diseases (Cholera, Meningitis, Yellow fever)

289.objective_name: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

290.name: Percentage of targeted population who attended wellness clinic at the District Hospital during a year
290.description: This measures the coverage of number of persons (18 years and above) who have received a health check-up at a wellness clinic during the year. (District hospitals and DHA) - provide pop 18 yrs and above.  Functional wellness clinic means 1. There is a designated place for wellness clinic. The place should be labelled and with directional sign   2. There is designated nurse(s) 3. The clinic has BP apparatus, Glucometer, weighing scale, tool for measuring height, register for documentation of services provided
290.objective_name: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

291.name: Proportion of functional risk communication and social mobilization committee
291.description:
Functional Risk communication and social mobilization committee refers to stakeholders who meet quarterly to discuss health issues affecting the Region and develop action plans and implement them.                                                                         Availability of minutes/pictures/participants list of meetings held with stakeholders.
-Availability of an action plan or implementation plan
- Evidence of action plan implemented
291.objective_name: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

292.name: Percentage of nurses demonstrating competence in NursMid documentation at the district Hospital
292.description: This shows the coverage of nurses demonstrating competence in NursMid documentation. It measures the number of nurses with requisite competencies in the standards of practice.  Verify from district hospitals
292.objective_name: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

293.name: Percentage of NursMid audit report at the District Hospital
293.description: This measures the coverage of NursMid audit report at the regional hospital per year. This is to assess how often NursMid audits are conducted at regional hospital to ensure compliance with the standards of documentation. It is to identify gaps in Nursing and Midwifery documentation towards continuous quality improvement. Four  (4) quarterly audit reports are expected.
293.objective_name: Objective 3: Increase access to responsive clinical and public health emergency services

fields.denominator: Total amount from Internally Generated Funds

fields.name: Proportion of Goods and services budget allocated to health research activities
fields.numerator: Total amount of budget allocated to research
fields.denominator: Total health budget(goods and services)
fields.description: Total amount of health budget (goods and services) allocated to research relative to the total health budget (goods and services) - all BMCs

fields.name: Percentage of Quarterly Internal Audits reports available (Sub Districts)
fields.numerator: Total number of Quarterly Internal Audits report available (Sub Districts)
fields.denominator: Total number of expected quarterly internal audit reports (Sub Districts)
fields.description: This measures the coverage of quarterly internal audits reports submitted by Sub districts. It is an indication of availability of Quarterly Internal Audits reports at Sub District level. Since it is quarterly reports the total report is the number of sub districts and  internal audit reports multiply by three  (3*) exclude forth quarter. Check if Audit report is of standardized format

fields.name: Percentage of internal and external audits recommendations implemented
fields.numerator: Total number of internal and external audit recommendations implemented
fields.denominator: Total number of internal and external audit recommendations
fields.description: This assess the coverage of internal and external audit recommendations implemented. It serves as evidence of implementation of recommendations of internal and external audits.

fields.name: Percentage of DHDs Districts with Budgets for Goods and Services captured into PBMIS
fields.numerator: Total number of Districts with Budget of Goods and services captured into PBMIS
fields.denominator: Total number of Districts per region
fields.description: Percentage of Districts with their Budgets for Goods and Services entered into PBMIS

fields.name: Family planning Acceptor rate
fields.numerator: Total number of women in reproductive age group who are using any modern family planning method
fields.denominator: Total number of  women in the reproductive age group
fields.description: The number of women in reproductive age group who are using modern contraceptives relative to the total number of women in reproductive age group(15-49 years)

fields.name: Total estimated protection by contraceptive methods supplied (Couple Year Protection (CYP) for long term
fields.numerator: The sum of all the CYPs long term of all the contraceptives sold or distributed free of charge to clients
fields.description: The estimated protection provided by family planning (FP) services during a one-year period, based upon the volume of all long term contraceptives sold or distributed free of charge to clients during that period

fields.name: Proportion of deliveries attended by trained health workers
fields.numerator: Total number of deliveries attended by a trained health worker
fields.denominator: Total  number of deliveries (pregnancies)
fields.description: Total number of deliveries that were attended by a trained health worker relative to the estimated total number of deliveries

fields.name: Proportion of newborns receiving postnatal care (PNC) within 48 hours from birth
fields.numerator: Total number of newborn babies who were seen for postnatal care within the first 48 hours
fields.denominator: Total deliveries
fields.description: Total number of newborn babies who were seen for postnatal care within the first 48hours relative to the total estimated deliveries

fields.name: Proportion of mothers who made at least four ANC visits
fields.numerator: Total number of pregnant women making their fourth antenatal visit
fields.denominator: Total number of antenatal registrants
fields.description: Total number of pregnant women making the 4th visit to antenatal relative to the total antenatal registrants

fields.name: The proportion of children due for Measles-Rubella 2 receiving  LLIN
fields.numerator: Total number of children given LLINs
fields.denominator: Total number of children under five years
fields.description: Total number of children under five years of age due for measles Rubella 2 given LLIN at CWC relative to the Total number of children under five years

fields.name: Percentage of babies breastfeeding within 1hr after delivery
fields.numerator: Total number of newborns breastfed within 1 hour of birth
fields.denominator: Total number of live babies in specified time period
fields.description: Percentage of newborns breastfed within 1 hour of birth in a specified period

fields.name: Doctor to population ratio
fields.numerator: Total population
fields.denominator: Total number of Physician Assistants (public sector)
fields.source_of_data: Human Resource Department/DHIMS2 for the population
fields.description: Total population served by one Doctor

fields.name: Nurse to population ratio
fields.numerator: Total population
fields.denominator: Total number of nurses (public sector)
fields.source_of_data: Human Resource Department/DHIMS2 for the population
fields.description: Total population served by one nurse (both proffessional and auxillary excluding midwives) - includes CHN, ER

fields.name: Midwife to Women in Fertility Age (WIFA) population ratio
fields.numerator: Total population of women in fertility age(15-49years)
fields.denominator: Total number of midwives (public sector)
fields.source_of_data: Human Resource Department/DHIMS2 for the population
fields.description: Total population served by one midwife

fields.name: Percentage of new vehicles with valid comprehensive insurance policy and road worthy certificates
fields.numerator: Number of new vehicles up to 5 yrs with valid comprehensive insurance policy and road worthy certificate
fields.denominator: Number of new vehicles
fields.description: Percentage of new vehicles up to 5yrs with valid comprehensive insurance policy and road worthy certificates

fields.name: Proportion of health facilities with equipment Inventory
fields.numerator: Number of Health Facilities with equipment Inventory
fields.denominator: Total number of Health facilities
fields.source_of_data: Asset Register (Updated and signed by RDHS)
fields.description: Number of health facilities with equipment inventory relative to the total number of health facilities

fields.name: eLMIS(GhiLMIS) capacity utilization rate
fields.numerator: Number of facilities that used GhiLMIS to conduct all the three basic logistics functions
fields.denominator: Number of onboarded facilities
fields.description: This indicator measures the percentage of facilities onboarded on an eLMIS (GhiLMIS) platform that used the system for ordering, receipt, and consumption of products within a specified period. The criteria for capacity utilization require onboarded facilities to conduct all the three basic logistics functions using the system. The denominator for this indicator is the total number of onboarded facilities while the numerator represents facilities that met the established criteria.

fields.name: Percentage of completeness of new entries in Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS)
fields.numerator: Number of new entrants keyed into HRMIS
fields.denominator: Total number of new entrants who assumed duty
fields.description: This measures the coverage of completeness of new entries in Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS) - Payroll system for processing of salaries of new entrants employees who assumed duty

fields.name: Percentage of completeness of Financial Returns in DHIMS2
fields.numerator: Total number of financial reports completed in DHIMS2
fields.denominator: Total number of expected Financial Reports I DHIMS2
fields.description: This measures the coverage of completeness of Financial Returns in DHIMS2

fields.name: Percentage of medication therapy discrepancies/errors identified and resolved (Hospitals, Polyclinics and Health Centres)
fields.numerator: Total number of medication therapy discrepancies/errors resolved
fields.denominator: Total number of medication therapy discrepancies identified
fields.description: As a quality indicator it measures the coverage of medication therapy discrepancies/errors identified and resolved - provide description of medications

fields.name: Midwife to WIFA population geographical equity index
fields.numerator: Midwife to WIFA ratio for the best performing District
fields.denominator: Midwife to WIFA ratio for the worst performing district
fields.description: Equitable distribution of Midwives by districts in the region

fields.name: Physician population geographical equity index
fields.numerator: Physician population ratio in the best performing district
fields.denominator: Physician population ratio in the worst performing district
fields.description: The extent to which physicians’ distribution by districts in the region is equitable

fields.name: Nurse population geographical equity index
fields.description: The extent to which nurses’ distribution by districts in the region is equitable

fields.name: Proportion of functional Community-Based Health Planning and Services (CHPS) zones
fields.description: The number of functional CHPS zones relative to the number of demarcated CHPS zones in the region for the given period

fields.name: Proportion of Proposed Network of Practise establised by Districts
fields.description: Number of  NOP establised relative to the total number of proposed NOP by the region.  The percentage of networks per districts per Sub District - Thirty (30) percent of Sub Districts in the District per year

fields.name: Percentage of Sub-Districts implementing Community Score card
fields.description: This measures the coverag of community score card by Sub-Districts

fields.name: Percentage of Policy Dissemenated at District Level
fields.description: This measures the Policy Dissemenation Coverage at District level. This is useful to assess how many GHS policies are dissemenated every year. At most four GHS policies are to be disseminated every quarter.

fields.name: Skilled delivery geographical equity index
fields.description: Supervised delivery spread by districts in the region

fields.name: Per capita Out Patient Department (OPD) attendance
fields.description: The number of outpatient visits to health facilities during the period relative to the total population of the same geographical area. Health facilities include all public, private, non-governmental and community-based health facilities in which general health services are offered.

fields.name: Percentage adherence to procurement plan
fields.description: Total items procured over the period by the Regional Health Directorate that was listed in the procurement plan

fields.name: Proportion of planned Integrated Districts supervisory visits undertaken
fields.description: Total number of integrated supervisory visits undertaken by region to the districts using standard checklist with reports written per total number of supervisions scheduled within the period

fields.name: Percentage of planned  Data validation meetings held by District
fields.description: Proportion of planned monthly data validation meetings held  by District Health Directorate( Data validation meetings are to be held monthly)- Evidence of minutes of meeting

fields.name: Proportion of health facilities providing data in DHIMS2
fields.description: Total number of health facilities(public and private) currently reporting in DHIMS2 relative to the total number of facilities in the region

fields.name: Percentage of Sub Districts who submitted quarterly data validation reports to DDHS
fields.description: This measures the coverage of Sub Districts that have submitted quarterly data validation reports to District Director of Health Services (DDHS). The Sub District Data Validation Report should be signed and approved by the Sub District In-Charge

fields.name: Completeness of reporting by health facilities
fields.description: The average number of data sets received relative to the total number of data sets expected for all reporting forms

fields.name: Proportion of facility deaths that are medically certified
fields.description: Total number of deaths that are medically certified with cause of death certificate and entered into the DHIMS2-COD module per the total number of deaths (aggregated) reported by facilities in the Region

fields.name: Incidence rate of diabetes (using OPD as proxy)
fields.description: Total number of NEW cases of diabetes reporting at health facilities outpatient departments during the period per the total population at risk - 18 yrs and above

fields.name: Incidence rate of Hypertension (using OPD as proxy)
fields.numerator: Total NEW cases of Hypertension reporting at health facilities outpatient department
fields.denominator: Total population of the Region
fields.description: Total number of NEW cases of Hypertension reporting at health facilities outpatient departments during the period per the total population at risk - 18 yrs and above

fields.name: Proportion of children U5 who were measured to assess stunting
fields.description: Percentage of children (0-59months) who at registration had their length/height measured to assess stunting

fields.name: Prevalence of anaemia in pregnant women at 36 weeks of gestation
fields.description: Percentage of pregnant women at 36 week with haemoglobin concentration of less than 11g/dl.

fields.name: Percentage of Children 6-59 months receiving Routine Vitamin A
fields.description: Percentage of children aged 6–59 months who received two age-appropriate doses of vitamin A in the past 12 months

fields.name: Percentage of ANC Registrants within the First Trimester
fields.description: Percentage of ANC registrants registered in 1st trimester

fields.name: Penta 3 coverage
fields.description: Percentage of children 0-11 months who received Penta 3 vaccine per estimated children 0-11 months

fields.name: Percentante of Children under five years who are underweight
fields.description: Percentage of underweight (moderate and severe) children aged 0-59 months (moderate- weight-for-age below -2 standard deviations of the WHO Child Growth standards median; Severe= weight-for-age below -3 standard deviations of the WHO Child Growth Standards median)

fields.name: Institutional all-cause mortality rate
fields.description: All of the deaths that occur in an institution, regardless of the cause relative to total Admissions

fields.name: Institutional Maternal Mortality Ratio per 100,000
fields.description: The total number of female deaths from any cause related to or aggravated by pregnancy and its management (excluding accidental or incidental causes)during  pregnancy and childbirth or within 42 days of termination of pregnancy irrespective of the duration and site of the pregnancy, expressed per 100,000 live births over a specified period

fields.name: Institutional Neonatal Mortality Rate per 1000
fields.description: The probability that a child born in a specific time period will die in the first 28 completed days of life in a health facility.

fields.name: Still birth rate
fields.description: Number of stillbirths per 1000 total births. Stillbirths can occur antepartum or intra partum. For purpose of international comparisons, stillbirths are defined as fetal deaths from 28weeks to birth

fields.name: Institutional Malaria Under 5 Case Fatality Rate
fields.description: Total number of deaths in children less than five years relative to the total number of children less than five years who were admitted with malaria

fields.name: Measles-Rubella 2 coverage
fields.description: Percentage of children 0-11 months who received Measles Rubella 2 vaccine per estimated children 0-11 months

fields.name: Percentage of maternal deaths that are audited
fields.description: The number of maternal deaths audited by Hospital audit Committees per 100 total maternal deaths in the facility

fields.name: Proportion of Total Mortality  attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (Cholera,, Typhoid fever and Paratyphoid)
fields.description: Total number of deaths attributed to Cholera, dysentery, Typhoid fever and diarrhea per 100 total deaths. (Would be assessed only if COD line listing is >80% of deaths in the inpatient summary sheet

fields.name: Proportion of total mortality attributed to external causes (Road traffic accidents, Falls, accidental poisoning and exposure to noxious substances, Accidental drowning, other transport accidents)
fields.description: Total number of deaths attributed to external causes( Road traffic accidents and Home accidents) per 100 total deaths Would be assessed only if COD line listing is >80% of deaths in the inpatient summary sheet

fields.name: Proportion of total mortality attributed to non-communicable  diseases   ( Neoplasm, Circulatory and cardiac conditions, Diabetes, Chronic Obstructive respiratory diseases)
fields.description: Total number of deaths attributed to non-communicable  diseases            (Neoplasm, Circulatory and cardiac conditions, Chronic Obstructive respiratory diseases). Would be assessed only if COD line listing is >80% of deaths in the inpatient summary sheet

fields.name: Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres (GHS/CHAG as public) providing traditional and alternate medicine
fields.description: Total number of Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres providing traditional and alternate medicine per the total number of Hospitals, Polyclinics & Health Centres in the District

fields.name: Average length of stay at the accident and emergency (A&E) ward of the District Hospital/Any Facility providing Inpatient care
fields.description: The average duration of emergency admissions (mean no. of days from admission. to discharge)

fields.name: Percentage Bed occupancy rate (all hospitals)
fields.description: The percentage of beds occupied by clients in a given period

fields.name: Proportion of hospitals (public - GHS/CHAG) with functional emergency department
fields.description: Total number of public hospitals in the Region with functional emergency department( Functional means having a team trained to handle emergencies and having a unit or department in the hospital that handles emergencies

fields.name: Percentage of Hospitals with Functional Public Health Units
fields.description: Total number of hospitals with  functional (has a department which is manned by someone with training in public health)  public health units relative to the total number of Hospitals in the district

fields.name: Average number of medicines prescribed per patient encounter (public facilities )
fields.description: Total number of medicines prescribed for the selected prescriptions

fields.name: Percentage of encounters with an injection prescribed (public facilities)
fields.description: Number of prescriptions with injections prescribed

fields.name: Percentage of medicines prescribed by generic name (public facilities)
fields.description: Number of medicines prescribed by generic names

fields.name: Percentage of prescriptions with antibiotics (public facilities)
fields.description: Number of prescriptions with antibiotics prescribed

fields.name: Tracer medicines availability at the District Hospital
fields.description: Number of tracer medicines in stock at the end of the period. Use updated tracer medicines list

fields.name: Percentage of District Hospitals with functional Total Quality Management (TQM) Teams
fields.description: This measures the coverage of District Hospitals with functional QA teams

fields.name: Proportion of attempted suicide
fields.description: Number of persons who attempted suicide per 100,000 Population per year

fields.name: Incidence of depression
fields.description: Number of new clients diagnosed with depression per 100,000 Population per year

fields.name: Cataract surgery (Surgical) rate
fields.description: It is the number of cataract operations performed in a year  per million population. It is a measure of quantity of cataract services.

fields.name: ART coverage rate
fields.description: Percentage of PLHIV currently receiving ART relative to the  Estimated number of PLHIV

fields.name: Viral load testing coverage rate
fields.description: Percentage of PLHIV tested for viral load relative to the number eligible for viral load testing

fields.name: PMTCT testing coverage rate
fields.description: Percentage of pregnant women attending ANC and/or who had a facility-based delivery who were tested for HIV during pregnancy or already knew they were HIV- positive. relative to the Number of pregnant women who attended ANC or had a facility- based delivery

fields.name: TB Case fatality rate
fields.description: Total number of TB patients who died during the period per the total number put on treatment during the period

fields.name: TB Case notification rate
fields.description: Number of new and relapse TB cases notified in a given period per 100,000 population

fields.name: TB treatment success rate
fields.description: Percentage of TB cases successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among TB cases notified to the national health authorities during a specified period

fields.name: Proportion of suspected malaria cases that were tested for malaria before treatment
fields.description: Percentage of suspected malaria cases that were confirmed before treatment using either microscopy or RDT per the total number of suspected cases

fields.name: Malaria mortality rate
fields.description: Total number of deaths attributable to malaria per 1000 population

fields.name: Non- polio AFP rate
fields.description: Total number of non-polio acute flaccid paralysis reported relative to the total number of children under fifteen years

fields.name: Surgical site infection rate
fields.description: Total Number of surgical wound Infections occurring within 10 days relative to the total number of surgeries performed

fields.name: PLHIV  newly enrolled in HIV care started on TB preventive therapy
fields.description: Percentage of PLHIV newly enrolled in HIV care who are started on treatment for latent TB infection Relative to the Total number of persons newly enrolled in HIV care, that is, registered in the pre-ART or ART register

fields.name: Percentage of infants born to HIV-infected mothers who are infected
fields.description: Percentage of babies born to HIV positive mothers who tested positive using DNA/PCR before 18 months relative to the total number of babies born to HIV positive mothers

fields.name: Proportion of pregnant women tested for syphilis
fields.description: Percentage of pregnant women who were tested for syphilis relative to the total number of pregnant women registered

fields.name: Malaria incidence per 1000 population
fields.description: Number of confirmed reported malaria cases per 1000 persons per year

fields.name: Percentage (%) of pregnant women on Intermittent preventive treatment (at least three doses of SP) according to national policy (HMIS)
fields.description: This indicator assesses the proportion of pregnant women attending antenatal clinics (registrants) who received at least 3 doses of IPTp under direct observation of a health worker. In Ghana, all pregnant women are required to receive minimum of three doses and maximum of 5 doses of SP, during regularly scheduled antenatal visits under the direct observation of a health worker. This indicator assesses the extent of implementation of IPTp for programmatic decisions.

fields.name: Case fatality rates for epidemic prone diseases (Cholera, Meningitis, Yellow fever)
fields.description: Total number of deaths attributed to Cholera, Meningitis, Yellow fever per total number of cases of these three conditions reported

fields.name: Percentage of targeted population who attended wellness clinic at the District Hospital during a year
fields.description: This measures the coverage of number of persons (18 years and above) who have received a health check-up at a wellness clinic during the year. (District hospitals and DHA) - provide pop 18 yrs and above.  Functional wellness clinic means 1. There is a designated place for wellness clinic. The place should be labelled and with directional sign   2. There is designated nurse(s) 3. The clinic has BP apparatus, Glucometer, weighing scale, tool for measuring height, register for documentation of services provided

fields.name: Proportion of functional risk communication and social mobilization committee
fields.description:
Functional Risk communication and social mobilization committee refers to stakeholders who meet quarterly to discuss health issues affecting the Region and develop action plans and implement them.                                                                         Availability of minutes/pictures/participants list of meetings held with stakeholders.
-Availability of an action plan or implementation plan
- Evidence of action plan implemented

fields.name: Percentage of nurses demonstrating competence in NursMid documentation at the district Hospital
fields.description: This shows the coverage of nurses demonstrating competence in NursMid documentation. It measures the number of nurses with requisite competencies in the standards of practice.  Verify from district hospitals

fields.name: Percentage of NursMid audit report at the District Hospital
fields.description: This measures the coverage of NursMid audit report at the regional hospital per year. This is to assess how often NursMid audits are conducted at regional hospital to ensure compliance with the standards of documentation. It is to identify gaps in Nursing and Midwifery documentation towards continuous quality improvement. Four  (4) quarterly audit reports are expected.
